newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume plunged to 1.6 billion yuan from a heavy 4.2 billion on Monday, with the seven-day contract the most active.
Traders said early-maturing contracts ended down today mainly due to reduced short-term demand for money from financial institutions with the approach of the year-end.
Traders expect institutional account settlement around the year-end will reduce liquidity in the domestic A share market, reducing demand on the interbank market.
"In the short term, the rates are likely to move in a narrow range, with trading volume light," said one trader.
